items.summary: Approve only the six zero-spend, reversible routing-only repairs listed below. Scope is limited to owner metadata, focused validation, canonical-task cleanliness, no duplication, and rollback metadata. Reject revenue, ROI, causal-lift, security-clearance, launch-readiness, production, telemetry, credential/configuration, dependency, spending, schedule, and high-priority queue claims. If any task is dirty, duplicated, or validation fails, stop and preserve it for repair. Owner: attribution is aggregate, telemetry and operations evidence are incomplete, and routing acceptance is not delivery or financial evidence.
